title: kid desire - Purple
htmlContent:
kid desire drops a new single called "Purple". He delivers in every way to make must hear music for his fans, and people all over the world looking for great music to enjoy.

kid desire delivers an instant smash on his new song “Purple". The music is big time, and kid desire’s larger than life presence is big enough to handle the moment. The production sets the perfect tone, for the writing to shine brighter than ever, with great verses and a chorus packed with appeal to take this records to it’s rightful destination in the stars.
